questions.stem: Why was Darwin's theory of evolution controversial when it was first published?

options.text: Because it was supported by too much evidence
Because it challenged the religious belief that God created all species
Because Darwin had never studied biology
Because no one had heard of natural selection before

questions.explanation: Darwin's theory was controversial because it contradicted the widely held belief that all species were created by God and had not changed. It also lacked a mechanism for inheritance (genetics was not yet understood).
